```{r}
Ce_tree <- ape::read.tree("/Users/ykang/YJ_writing/Evo_Agg_paper/V2/WI.20250625.hard-filter.isotype.min4.tree")
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(Ce_tree, setdiff(Ce_tree$tip.label, wild_strain))
plot(tree_pruned)
add.scale.bar(x=0.1,y=5,length=0.05, lwd=2, cex = 3, font = 1, lcol = "black", col="black")
#x=0.15,y=193
```

```{r}
tree_extend <- tree_pruned # make copy
N <- Ntip(tree_extend)
root_node <- N + 1
root_to_tip <- dist.nodes(tree_extend)[1:N, root_node] # root to tip distances of each tip
age_difference <- max(root_to_tip) - root_to_tip # difference from each root-to-tip distance to their maximum
tip_edges <- tree_extend$edge[, 2] <= Ntip(tree_extend) # grab the edges from the edge matrix that correspond to the tips. Note that the edges in $edge.label correspond to the row numbers in $edge, not the values in those rows
tree_extend$edge.length[tip_edges] <- tree_extend$edge.length[tip_edges] + age_difference # extend the tips outwards
is.ultrametric(tree_extend) # yes
#plot(tree_extend)
    
tree_pruned<-drop.tip(tree_extend, setdiff(tree_extend$tip.label, glmm_df$strain))
plot(tree_pruned)
#row.names(values_complete)<-values_complete$strain

cor_struct <- corBrownian(1, tree_pruned) #corBrownian(phy = tree_pruned)  #corBrownian(1, tree_pruned)
```

```{r}
your_data <- glmm_df[rownames(glmm_df) %in% tree_pruned$tip.label, ]
# Reorder data to match tree tip order
your_data <- your_data[match(tree_pruned$tip.label,rownames(your_data)), ]
# Double check:
stopifnot(all(rownames(your_data) == tree_pruned$tip.label))
values_complete<-your_data[complete.cases(your_data),]
values_complete
```

```{r}
#pdf("/Users/ykang/Desktop/Ce_tree_heatmap.pdf", width=5.5, height=5.5)
sub_tree <- drop.tip(Ce_tree, setdiff(Ce_tree$tip.label, wild_strain))
sub_tree$edge.length <- pmax(tree_pruned$edge.length-0.001, 0.019)
sub_tree <- force.ultrametric(sub_tree, method = "extend")  

heat_df<-values_complete[,2:10]
heat_df <- heat_df[,ncol(heat_df):1]
heat_df_scaled <- as.matrix(scale(heat_df[sub_tree$tip.label, ]))
open_angle <- 15
plot(sub_tree, type = "fan", cex = 0.4, no.margin = TRUE, rotate.tree = 90, open.angle = 15, lwd = 0.5, )

# Retrieve last plot coordinates (ape stores them in a hidden object)
last_plot <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv)
tip_coords <- cbind(last_plot$xx[1:length(sub_tree$tip.label)],
                    last_plot$yy[1:length(sub_tree$tip.label)])
tip_angles <- atan2(tip_coords[, 2], tip_coords[, 1])
label_angle_deg <- 360 - open_angle/2
label_angle_rad <- label_angle_deg * pi / 180
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue4", "beige"))(100) #beige, royalblue4
base_radius <- max(sqrt(rowSums(tip_coords^2))) * 0.764
ring_spacing <- 0.0138
arc_width <- 0.01

par(lend = 2)
# Loop through each trait (column) and draw colored segments (rings)
n_traits <- ncol(heat_df_scaled)
for (i in seq_len(n_traits)) {
  radius <- base_radius + (i - 1) * ring_spacing
  trait_vals <- heat_df_scaled[, i]
  cols <- colors[cut(trait_vals, breaks = 100, labels = FALSE)]
  for (j in seq_along(tip_angles)) {
    theta <- tip_angles[j]
    segments(
      x0 = radius * cos(theta - arc_width/3),
      y0 = radius * sin(theta - arc_width/3),
      x1 = radius * cos(theta + arc_width/3),
      y1 = radius * sin(theta + arc_width/3),
      col = cols[j],
      lwd = 6.0
    )
  }
}

#colorbar
n_colors <- length(colors)
cb_x <- (base_radius + n_traits * ring_spacing + 0.25) * cos(label_angle_rad)
cb_y_bottom <- (base_radius - ring_spacing) * sin(label_angle_rad)
cb_y_top <- (base_radius + n_traits * ring_spacing + 0.25) * sin(label_angle_rad)
cb_y <- seq(cb_y_bottom, cb_y_top, length.out = n_colors + 1)
rect_width <- 0.018  # thickness of the colorbar

for (k in seq_len(n_colors)) {
  rect(
    xleft = cb_x - rect_width/2,
    xright = cb_x + rect_width/2,
    ybottom = cb_y[k],
    ytop = cb_y[k + 1],
    col = colors[k],
    border = NA
  )
}

min_val <- round(min(heat_df_scaled), 2)
max_val <- round(max(heat_df_scaled), 2)
text(cb_x + 0.03, cb_y_bottom, labels = min_val, adj = 0)
text(cb_x + 0.03, cb_y_top, labels = max_val, adj = 0)
```

```{r}
normal_scaling <- function(array){
    (array-mean(array, na.rm = TRUE))/(quantile(array,0.75, na.rm = TRUE)-quantile(array,0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
}

#normal scaling
values_complete_norm <- values_complete
values_complete_norm['aggregation'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$aggregation )
values_complete_norm['timescale'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$timescale )
values_complete_norm['elevation_m'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$elevation_m )
values_complete_norm['mu_temperature'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$mu_temperature )
values_complete_norm['mu_humidity'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$mu_humidity )
values_complete_norm['mu_soilmoist'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$mu_soilmoist )
values_complete_norm['std_temperature'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$std_temperature )
values_complete_norm['std_humidity'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$std_humidity )
values_complete_norm['std_soilmoist'] <- normal_scaling( values_complete$std_soilmoist )

values_complete_norm<-na.omit(values_complete_norm)
values_complete_norm
```

```{r}
library(brms)
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr")

A <- ape::vcv(tree_pruned, corr = TRUE)
A <- A[values_complete$strain, values_complete$strain]

env_model_lasso <- brm(
  aggregation ~ elevation_m + mu_temperature + mu_humidity + mu_soilmoist +
                std_temperature + std_humidity + std_soilmoist +
                (1 | gr(strain, cov = A)),
  data = values_complete,
  data2 = list(A = A),
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(prior(horseshoe(df = 1), class = "b")),  # LASSO-like shrinkage
  chains = 4, cores = 4
)

summary(env_model_lasso)
```


```{r}
predictors <- c("mu_temperature", "mu_humidity", "mu_soilmoist",
                 "std_temperature", "std_humidity", "std_soilmoist", "elevation_m")
response <- "aggregation"

all_subsets <- unlist(lapply(1:length(predictors), function(i) {
  combn(predictors, i, FUN = function(x) paste(x, collapse = " + "))
}), use.names = FALSE)

results <- data.frame(model = character(), AIC = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (subset in all_subsets) {
  formula_str <- paste(response, "~", subset)
  model <- gls(as.formula(formula_str), data = values_complete_norm, method = "ML", na.action = na.omit)
  results <- rbind(results,
                   data.frame(model = formula_str, AIC = AIC(model)))
}

results <- results[order(results$AIC), ]
head(results)

env_model <- gls(
  aggregation ~  elevation_m+mu_temperature+mu_humidity+mu_soilmoist+std_temperature+std_humidity+std_soilmoist,
    #elevation_m +std_temperature,
  data = values_complete_norm,
  correlation = cor_struct, #corAR1(form = ~1 | climate)
  method = "REML"
)
values_complete$corrected_agg <- fitted(env_model)
summary(env_model)

ggplot(values_complete, aes(y=corrected_agg, x=elevation_m )) +  #corrected_y
  geom_point(shape = 16, alpha = 0.8, size = 3)
ggplot(values_complete, aes(y=corrected_agg, x=std_temperature )) +  #corrected_y
  geom_point(shape = 16, alpha = 0.8, size = 3)
```

```{r}
predictors <- c("mu_temperature", "mu_humidity", "mu_soilmoist",
```
